audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer rated the lane TRICKY 7/10 while the data says the opposite: 55.15% WR over 651 games, packet level chart Naafiri in all seven stages, and every content why argues Naafiri favoured (Annie has zero mobility to answer three dashes).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[4] and [6] said side Annie against content win[4]/win[6] = Naafiri — a two-layer chart disagreement on a paying user's page. Remaining rows were blanket 'Skill'.
audit.why: Packet chart is all Naafiri; the level 6 and late whys in content are grounded (bait the four-stack stun, she has no escape from W/R).
audit.corrected: All seven full sides set to Naafiri with matching why rewrites for the rows that changed meaning.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is Pyromania: four casts stock a stun, and Flash-Tibbers (R 130/115/100s, 600 range) is her only kill pattern — eat the stun on a packmate/minion, then commit; Naafiri W untargetability blanks a timed Tibbers burst. Her E (10s) reflects damage onto attackers — relevant to a five-hound pile. tldr/winCon referenced a nonexistent 'silence'; cooldowns had no digit.
audit.why: Annie P text (4 casts, starts stocked), R CD 130s, E 10s reflect; Naafiri W flag.
audit.corrected: Stated across tldr, winCon, cooldowns, dosFull[1], dontsFull[2].
